description: Defines the class 'ocudu::lcid_dl_sch_t' representing Logical Channel IDs (LCID) for PDSCH in 3GPP LTE/NR, including enumerations, validation, and size functions, along with a formatter specialization.

classes.name: ocudu::lcid_dl_sch_t
classes.description: Represents LCID for PDSCH with methods for validation, size, and conversion.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assigns an underlying type value to the LCID object with validation.

methods.name: operator underlying_type()
methods.description: Explicit cast to underlying integer type.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns the underlying integer value of the LCID.

methods.name: is_ce
methods.description: Checks if LCID is a MAC Control Element.

methods.name: is_sdu
methods.description: Checks if LCID belongs to a Radio Bearer Logical Channel.

methods.name: to_lcid
methods.description: Converts LCID to lcid_t type after validation.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if LCID value is valid (not reserved).

methods.name: is_var_len_ce
methods.description: Indicates if the CE is variable length (always false here).

methods.name: sizeof_ce
methods.description: Returns size in bytes of the control element based on LCID.
